shared_elements: carved stone in a tall, roughly rectangular vertical block
incised/relief eyes rendered as recessed ovals
frontal, symmetrical emphasis in the upper zone
justification: Both are tall pale stone blocks whose upper zone is dominated by paired, deeply cut eye forms, which gives a faint echo of a face-like frontal emphasis. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a three-dimensional sculpted head with modelled brow, nose and cheeks and no ornament, while B is a flat slab covered in shallow low-relief registers of animals, birds and a band of repeated marks.
